title: Wreck and Landfall
premise: Salvage diver Casper Pemberton recovers a chest stamped with the seal of Vessany, a drowned nation erased from maps and treaties forty years ago. Inside are documents proving the river delta's land was stolen from Vessan exiles through a forged treaty — and a map to the nation's sealed archive at the glacier source. Pursued by a navy contractor who wants the chest destroyed and shadowed by an aging Vessan exile who wants it weaponized, Casper runs the river upstream through rapids, checkpoints, and her own buried past as a smuggler's daughter. At the calving glacier she reaches the archive just as the ice opens, choosing neither side: she publishes the truth to the river towns themselves, letting the people who live on the water decide their own inheritance. The contractor falls, the exile gains a homeland in memory rather than territory, and Casper finally stops measuring life in miles.
about_author: Rafael Yarrow is a former river pilot who spent six seasons running cargo on glacial headwaters before turning to fiction full-time. He writes adventure novels about people who belong to water more than to nations.

chapters.title: The Bottom of the Channel
chapters.summary: Casper dives a navy-restricted wreck site at dawn, establishing her solitary, transactional life measured in dive logs and paid miles. Third-person limited from Casper. Emotional beat: competent loneliness — she's good at being no one.

chapters.title: Chest of a Dead Nation
chapters.summary: Her dredge hooks something off-survey: a lead-lined chest bearing the Vessan seal. She opens it alone at night and finds treaty documents and a wax-sealed map. POV Casper. Beat: curiosity curdling into dread as she realizes what the navy will do to keep this quiet.

chapters.title: Men Who Buy Silence
chapters.summary: A contractor named Aldous Vey offers Casper triple rate to forget the find; she takes the money, then can't sleep. POV Casper with a short Vey scene showing his cold institutional menace. Beat: the first crack in her invisibility — guilt has a price tag.

chapters.title: The Exile at the Ferry Landing
chapters.summary: An old woman, Maren Ostrev, recognizes the seal on Casper's boat tarp and begs to see the documents. She reveals she is one of the last Vessan-born. POV Casper. Beat: belonging offered like a hand across water — and refused.

chapters.title: What the Treaty Forged
chapters.summary: Maren shows Casper how the 40-year-old treaty signatures were forged, dispossessing thousands. The navy arrives at Casper's dock asking questions. POV alternates Casper and a navy officer, Brandt, who suspects but hesitates. Beat: the past stops being past.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: Vey's men torch Casper's salvage barge; she escapes with the chest and map into the night river. First-person interlude from Casper's old logbook reveals her smuggler father died running this same current. Beat: grief and fury fused into forward motion.

chapters.title: Downstream Is a Trap
chapters.summary: Casper realizes every exit leads to Vey's network; only upstream — toward the forbidden source and the Vessan archive — offers leverage. She grudgingly accepts Maren aboard. POV Casper. Beat: alliance born of necessity, not trust.

chapters.title: Rapids at Kell's Folly
chapters.summary: A brutal whitewater passage nearly kills them; Maren reveals local knowledge that saves them, proving her worth. POV Casper. Beat: respect kindled in spray and terror; the boat becomes a fragile home.

chapters.title: Checkpoint at the Tollhouse
chapters.summary: They bluff past a river toll run by Vey's subcontractors; Casper uses her salvager credentials one last time, burning her old identity. POV Casper with Brandt arriving behind them, doubting his orders. Beat: no way back now.

chapters.title: The Town That Remembers
chapters.summary: In a delta town, they find Vessan descendants keeping quiet traditions — songs, names, a hidden chapel. Maren is recognized; Casper watches a community she never had. POV shifts partly to Maren. Beat: envy and longing; inheritance is not just paper.

chapters.title: Brandt's Doubt
chapters.summary: Officer Brandt examines the burned barge, finds evidence Vey ordered it, and begins quietly working against his employer. POV Brandt. Beat: justice stirring inside the machine that forbids it.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Narrows
chapters.summary: Vey's gunboat corners them in a gorge; a desperate night escape through a flooded side channel costs them supplies and nearly Maren's life. POV Casper. Beat: fear sharpened into resolve; the stakes turn lethal.

chapters.title: The Map's Second Layer
chapters.summary: Repairing the water-damaged map, Casper discovers a second layer: the archive isn't just records — it holds the original un-forged treaty, legally voiding the dispossession. POV Casper. Beat: hope with a deadline — the calving season window.

chapters.title: Cold Country
chapters.summary: Above the last towns, the river turns glacial; they portage through moraine while Vey's helicopter sweeps the valley. Quiet chapter of endurance and confession between Casper and Maren. Beat: two lonely women becoming family on foot.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Weir
chapters.summary: A river guide they hired sells their position to Vey for debt forgiveness; they're captured, and Vey takes the chest, leaving them bound above the flood line. POV Casper. Beat: betrayal's bitter taste — and Maren's unexpected resourcefulness in escape.

chapters.title: The Long Climb
chapters.summary: Free but empty-handed, they climb toward the source on memory and Maren's childhood stories, racing the calving season's opening. POV alternating Casper and Maren. Beat: despair transmuted into stubbornness; the mountain doesn't care about their cause.

chapters.title: Brandt Breaks Ranks
chapters.summary: Brandt intercepts Vey's convoy upstream, ostensibly to retrieve the chest, actually to stall him. He radios Casper the route Vey will take. POV Brandt. Beat: a lawful man choosing justice outside the law.

chapters.title: Calving
chapters.summary: The glacier calves early; the ice-dammed lake bursts open the forbidden source route days ahead of schedule. Casper and Maren ride the flood surge through the newly opened gorge. POV Casper. Beat: nature as terrifying ally — the brief window is open NOW.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath the Ice
chapters.summary: They reach the Vessan vault carved into bedrock ahead of Vey's team; a standoff in the dark ends when Brandt arrives and arrests Vey on evidence Casper salvaged from the burned barge. Climax. Beat: courage, violence narrowly contained, truth physically seized.

chapters.title: Reading the Original
chapters.summary: By lamplight they read the true treaty aloud — the forgery exposed, the dispossession legally void. Maren weeps; Casper understands she's been inheriting all along. POV shared. Beat: catharsis; justice documented, if not yet delivered.

chapters.title: The River Decides
chapters.summary: They carry copies downstream to every river town; communities convene on the water to claim their own inheritance rather than wait for distant courts. Brandt testifies; Vey's network collapses. Beat: belonging chosen collectively — the theme made flesh.

chapters.title: Landfall
chapters.summary: Months later, Casper moors her rebuilt boat at the delta town, no longer counting miles. Maren plants a Vessan garden; Casper signs the town ledger with her real name. Resolution. Beat: arrival — invisible no more, home at last.
